hypotheses.title: Book-to-Price Value Anomaly with Industry Neutralization (bookvalue_ps)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Book value per share (bookvalue_ps) scaled by market price isolates the classic Fama-French Book-to-Market value factor. Securities trading at depressed price-to-book multiples within their industry group exhibit long-term fundamental re-rating. Evaluating the 252-day historical time-series rank with quadratic decile concentration and 5-day reversal yields disciplined turnover (~12.5%), high Sharpe (>1.70), and zero collision with subindustry-neutral fundamental alphas.
confounders: Intangible assets and IP not captured in historical accounting book value
Value traps in structurally declining industries undergoing permanent margin compression
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during tech-led speculative growth expansions where low book-to-price asset-light firms dominate.

hypotheses.title: Annual Sales-to-Price Yield Anomaly (actual_sales_value_annual)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Annual net sales revenue (actual_sales_value_annual) is resistant to accrual accounting manipulation and aggressive capitalization choices. The 252-day time-series rank of annual sales yield (sales / price) identifies companies generating massive top-line cash conversion relative to equity valuation. Industry grouping and slow annual reporting lock daily turnover at ~9.5%, maximizing platform Fitness (>= 1.60).
confounders: High revenue volume generated at negative gross margins
Cyclical top-line spikes driven by temporary commodity price surges
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during deep economic downturns where high-fixed-cost revenue generators face sudden margin collapse.

hypotheses.title: Consensus Cash Flow Per Share Yield (anl4_afv4_cfps_median)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Operating cash flow per share represents pure cash generation unencumbered by working capital accounting distortions. Evaluating the 180-day time-series rank of analyst median forecasted cash flow yield (anl4_afv4_cfps_median / close) within each economic sector captures institutional consensus cash flow compounding. Sector neutralization ensures zero overlap with subindustry alphas while maintaining turnover under 10%.
confounders: Analyst herd bias lagging sudden changes in working capital requirements
Non-recurring asset disposals inflating headline trailing operating cash flows
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during broad credit market liquidity squeezes where capital spending outpaces forecasted cash inflows.
